The Culture

Ten Daughters

Wanjiru, Wambui, Wanjeri, Wanjiku, Nyambura, Wairimu, Wangeci, Wangari, Wangui, Wamuyu: ten names every Gikuyu household knows, staged in full beadwork at the entrance as a reminder of what the whole day was standing on.

"Thaayũ mũno nĩ ũndũ wa kũrũgamĩrĩra Wendo na gwĩtĩkia mugambo witũ", printed on every Wendo 1.0 poster, in the language the festival was built to carry forward.
The Look

Burgundy & Beige

The dress code went out with the first poster and stuck: wine-dark reds against warm beige, the same two tones that ended up wrapping every stage screen and ticket stub on the ground.

The People

Who actually showed up

Anjiru, Wendo's word for its own crowd, dressed to code, held their wristbands up, and stayed past the surprise acts.
